hana (Marketing): Quick check: embargo lift planned for 09:00 PT tomorrow. Need PR + legal + growth signoff. Who can take notes?

sam (PR): I'll send embargo at 08:55 PT. Small ask: withhold raw bench spreadsheets from the pack.

tori (Legal): Agreed. Remove raw CSVs and partner logos until written approval. Also no comparative language.

riley (Design): Uploaded logo-free assets to drive (drive.redwood/launch/assets). Will swap if logos clear.

noah (Growth): Paid queues ready; holding 15% buffer for first 15m. UTMs will be utm_campaign=playbook_may.

alex (Product): Product monitoring 08:30-10:00 PT. We'll watch p95 latency and kv cache hit rate; ready to flip fallback if needed.

support (Support): Support coverage confirmed 08:45-10:30 PT. Adding a 3-line FAQ to the press kit for quick replies.

press-bot: reminder: preview probe at 08:58 PT and smoke test at 08:59 PT.

hana (Marketing): Timeline: 08:40 final assets, 08:55 embargo out, 08:58 preview, 09:00 publish + social. Tag me on anything blocking.

sam (PR): Draft embargo snippet ready; will personalize subjects for top outlets.

tori (Legal): I'll be on standby for last-minute wording edits.

hana (Marketing): Emoji check: :rocket: :white_check_mark: :eyes: Thanks team!
